root.label: CREW Hatch Act complaint over DHS attack on Janelle Stelson

events.label: CREW Hatch Act complaint over DHS attack on Janelle Stelson

slots.name: complaint count
slots.sentence: Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington filed a complaint Thursday with the U.S. Office of Special Counsel, calling the department’s attack on Stelson a blatant violation of the Hatch Act, which prohibits government officials from using their official positions to influence elections.
